In this new episode of Sail-Ho we are visiting Dugi Otok, the longest and biggest island of the Zadar archipelago. It is also the 2nd most indented island in all of the Adriatic Sea, with gorgeous beaches and beautiful nature we believe is worth exploring completely.

Welcome to Sail-Ho Croatia! We're in Rab, the island known by many as the island of love and happiness since Roman times. It has more than 30 sandy beaches, 2500 hours of sunshine and a mouthwatering gastronomy. Come join us and find out why this place is considered a happy place by so many.

Welcome to Inside Sailing, the TV program that brings you all the very best action from some of the most spectacular sailing events around the world. Sailing allows us to discover new horizons, challenges, and exciting journeys in some of the most breath-taking sceneries.
The World Sailing Show is a close up monthly view of the racing world, a global sailing series featuring the very best action from the world of sailing.

When the out-spending was impossible, out-thinking did the job. Emirates Team New Zealand has dominated the 35th America's Cup Match seven to one to become the new Defender. After nearly two decades, the end of both the Alinghi and Oracle Eras is here and the kiwis are back on the top of the world.

programmes.d: Coming up in this week's episode, the crews are ready for an all Australian adventure as they sail coast to coast. On reaching Sydney, they will join the blue riband Sydney Hobart Yacht Race with hundreds of other sailors..
